label: the walk view — the door at Wil's offset, the cards on the same lane, no scrolling while a stop is focused
notes: Wil's reply to round 19 on the live site (2026-09-18): 'Looks and appears to work fantastic.' Three asks. (1) The Take the Walk offset he picked on the device, ?cta=-4, ships as the default: --map-door-lift is a registered property with initial-value -4px, and the flag keeps working as an inline override. (2) The chapter cards, shown after Take the Walk or a pin tap, inherit the door's vertical spacing: one registered token, --map-lane, is the door's bottom offset AND the card strip's bottom padding at every width (phones inset + lift = 16px; 640 and up inset + 12px, the door's existing tablet/desktop offset), and the attribution row that rides above the cards while a stop is focused follows it — and now also takes E back, which the focused-state rule had never done since round 9, so on an iPhone the (i) and the Mapbox logo sat E lower than intended in the walk view. (3) No scrolling into the index while a stop is focused: round 1's E22 lock covered only walk === 'walking'; it now covers the whole focused state (wheel, touch, keys, the strip's touch-action), released by Back, Escape or a navigation. Base af0e747 = the v2 tip and the live site (Actions run 244); no base branch is pushed, the SHA above is the revert point. allowedRoutes is /map alone: the door moves 4px on phones at rest, so map--390 is refreshed; 768 and 1440 must not drift (the tablet/desktop door offset is unchanged), and no other route may.
